credits.title: New Recruit: Haunted Military Hospital
credits.overview: Seeking a sweet escape, a group of rookie soldiers is admitted to what they believe is a paradise-like military hospital, only to uncover its dark secrets as they confront a series of terrifying rumors.

credits.title: The Dude in Me
credits.overview: Dong-hyun is a high school student. One day, he falls from the rooftop and bumps into Pan-soo who is a passerby. Pan-soo is a member of a criminal organization. When the two men wake up in the hospital, they discover that they have switched bodies.
